mutants.why: the 0xEF53 magic gate must reject a NON-matching superblock; inverting != to == flags the valid fixture (magic present) as 'Ext superblock magic not found', so load() fails. extFileSystemReader_listsDirectoriesAndReadsFiles asserts QVERIFY2(root.ok) on the valid ext2 fixture

an extent node's eh_magic must equal 0xF30A; inverting != to == makes validateExtentNode append 'Invalid ext extent tree' for the valid ext4 root node, so the extent-mapped read fails. extFileSystemReader_readsExtentMappedFilesAndBlocksUnsafePaths asserts QVERIFY2(hello.ok) and QCOMPARE(hello.data, "hello from ext\n")

an incompat bit outside the recognized set must fail closed; inverting != to == lets the forged 0x00800000 bit through (no 'unknown incompatible' blocker) so the volume lists as if understood. extFileSystemReader_rejectsUnknownIncompatFeature asserts QVERIFY(!listing.ok) and blockers.contains("unknown incompatible")

a leaf extent whose physical run overruns blocks_count must be refused; flipping > to < accepts physical=4096 on a 64-block volume, so appendLeafExtent no longer emits the 'out-of-range' rejection. extFileSystemReader_rejectsMalformedExtentTree asserts QVERIFY(!physicalRead.ok) and blockers.contains("out-of-range")

readBlock must reject a block at/after the declared volume size; inverting >= to < both stops emitting 'past the declared volume size' for the crafted block 4096 and rejects every in-range block on the valid fixture. extFileSystemReader_boundsBlockAndInodeReferences asserts blockersFor(blockPastVolume).contains("past the declared volume size") (and the shared blockersFor QVERIFY(!listing.ok))

a zero/undersized on-disk inode_size must fail closed with an 'inode size' blocker; disabling the guard lets inode_size=0 through so the reader instead reports 'Selected ext path is not a directory' (a zeroed root inode). extFileSystemReader_rejectsMalformedSuperblockGeometry asserts blockers.contains("inode size")

s_first_data_block is fixed by the format (1 at 1KiB blocks, 0 above); inverting != to == accepts the malformed first_data_block=0 so the volume lists as valid and drops the 'first data block' blocker (and flags the valid fixture). extFileSystemReader_boundsBlockAndInodeReferences asserts blockersFor(wrongFirstBlock).contains("first data block") after QVERIFY(!listing.ok)

appendDirectoryRecord must skip only empty/deleted slots (inode==0); inverting to inode!=0 skips every real entry instead, so the root listing collapses to zero records. extFileSystemReader_listsDirectoriesAndReadsFiles asserts QCOMPARE(root.entries.size(), 3) and names.contains("hello.txt")
